#   * Final mean computed on host (division by N)
#   * All arithmetic in fp16, accumulation in fp32

import torch
import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Try to import TVM (TileLang) and build the kernel
# ------------------------------------------------------------

    from tvm import tir
    from tvm.script import tir as T

        pred: T.handle,          # [N] float16
        targ: T.handle,          # [N] float16
        out: T.handle,           # scalar float32 accumulator
        N: T.int64               # vector length
    ) -> None:
        T.func_attr({"global_symbol": "hinge_loss_fp16", "tir.noalias": True})
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        # buffers
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        pred_buf = T.match_buffer(pred, (N,), dtype="float16")
        targ_buf = T.match_buffer(targ, (N,), dtype="float16")
        out_buf  = T.match_buffer(out, (), dtype="float32")

        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        # thread configuration
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        block_size = 1024
        bx = T.env_thread("blockIdx.x")
        tx = T.env_thread("threadIdx.x")

        # number of blocks (grid dim)
        num_blocks = (N + block_size - 1) // block_size

        # shared memory for block‑wise reduction (fp32)
        s = T.alloc_buffer((block_size,), dtype="float32", scope="shared")

        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        # initialise shared memory to zero
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        with T.block("init_shared"):
            vi = T.axis.spatial(block_size, tx)
            s[vi] = T.float32(0.0)

        # -----------------------------------------------------------------

        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        stride = block_size * num_blocks
        i = bx * block_size + tx
        sum_fp32 = T.float32(0.0)
        with T.block("grid_loop"):
            while T.tvm_maybe_vectorized(i < N):
                # diff = 1 - pred * targ   (fp16)

                # clamp at 0

                # accumulate in fp32 register
                sum_fp32 = sum_fp32 + T.Cast("float32", clamped)
                i = i + stride

        # write thread‑local sum into shared memory
        with T.block("store_shared"):
            s[tx] = sum_fp32

        T.evaluate(T.tvm_storage_sync("shared"))

        # block‑level reduction in shared memory (tree reduction)
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------

        # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    ir_mod = tvm.IRModule({"hinge_loss_fp16": hinge_loss_fp16})
    dev = tvm.cuda(0)
